public static void main(String[] args) {
Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
long n = in.nextLong();
long m = in.nextLong();
long out = 0;

    System.out.println("0");
} else {
    if (n==1 || m==1) {
        long l = n+m-1;
        long x = l/6;
        long y = 0;
        if (l%6 == 4) y+= 2;

        out = x*6 + y;
        System.out.println(out);
        return;

System.out.println(out); // 
}
}
